title: Cheetah Net Supply Chain Service Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: Cheetah Net Supply Chain Service Inc. (ticker CTNT), a supply chain logistics company headquartered in Irvine, California, filed an 8-K disclosing a 1-for-200 reverse stock split that became effective on April 20, 2026. The split reduced Class A Common Stock outstanding from 391,177,712 shares to 1,955,889 shares and Class B Common Stock from 690,875 shares to 3,455 shares. The company completed an at-the-market equity offering of 355,000,000 shares prior to the split. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Reverse stock split of 1-for-200 became effective April 20, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. ET
Class A shares reduced from 391,177,712 to 1,955,889; Class B shares reduced from 690,875 to 3,455
Stock will trade on split-adjusted basis starting April 29, 2026 with new CUSIP 16307X301
Company sold 355,000,000 Class A shares in at-the-market transactions prior to split
Approve d February 3, 2026 by holders of approximately 79.16% of voting power via written consent
New ticker trading on Nasdaq under symbol CTNT
